title: Mission Control
summary: A control plane for running and steering multi-agent missions. A mission describes its goal, workflow, available agents and expected outputs.
architecture: Temporal coordinates scheduling and recovery. PostgreSQL records mission state. Provider adapters connect agent runtimes to a shared contract, with Deep Agents as the primary implementation.

title: Knowledge Services
summary: A shared foundation for preparing, retrieving and verifying knowledge. Its services connect source material to evidence that agents can retrieve.
architecture: A TypeScript monorepo separates preparation, retrieval, evaluation and verification packages. HTTP, MCP and CLI entry points expose contracts for callers, while durable workers handle background work.
